## session work

Get the work tied to a session

Lists visible linked work and its progress. Every signed-in person has their own computers and sessions and reaches only those; anyone else's answers 404.

```bash
nb-studio session work <session>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `session` |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/agentSessions/sessions/{sessionId}/work` (`agentSessionsGetSessionWork`)
